migrationReview.title: DF 2026 Migration Review
migrationReview.intro: Review characters migrated to DF 2026. Pick five Rank-2 Specializations (legacy Skills are listed for reference). Saving only changes Specializations and Echo Imprints — XP, Stones, Powers and Artifacts stay untouched.
migrationReview.legacySkillsHint: These are the Skills this character had before DF 2026. Ratings are for reference only — they do not become Spec Ranks. Use + to copy a name into the Rank-2 list below.
migrationReview.noLegacySkills: No rated legacy Skills were found on this character.
migrationReview.startingSpecsHint: Choose exactly five free-named Specializations. Each is Rank 2 — there is no Rank picker (same as character creation).
migrationReview.maxSpecs: Choose at most five Specializations (all Rank 2).

applySpecial.TypeHint: Apply a Special when tokens enter (stop at the boundary; remaining movement stays usable) and/or at round end while still inside.

value.label: Value (X)
value.hint: Used when the Special has a numeric rank (e.g. Ignite(2)).

applyOnEnter.label: On enter
applyOnEnter.hint: Stop at the region boundary, apply the Special, then allow remaining Movement Action meters on a new move.

applyOnRoundEnd.label: On round end (while inside)
applyOnRoundEnd.hint: Apply again at combat round end to tokens still inside.

mode.label: Apply mode
mode.hint: Normally follows stacking/cap rules; Override sets the stored value exactly.

DF_PARTICLE_EFFECTS.TypeHint: Visual natural fire clipped to this region. It does not deal damage or change tokens.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.hint: Turn this fire on or off without deleting the behavior. The region's own Disabled checkbox also hides it. While this window is open, the map previews your changes. Close it without saving and the preview goes away.

effectType.label: Effect Type
effectType.hint: Natural Fire is the only effect in this version. Later effects can be added here without a new behavior type.

arrangement.label: Arrangement
arrangement.hint: Single flame stacks the sprites into one fire at the center of the region. Field scatters many flames. Density only affects Field.

density.label: Density
density.hint: How many flame sites to place for this region's area, counted in grid cells. 0 hides a field of flames. Single flame ignores density.

flameScale.label: Flame Scale
flameScale.hint: Size of each flame relative to the scene grid. The flame base stays on the ground.

flameSpeed.label: Flame Speed
flameSpeed.hint: How fast flicker, sway, and rising embers move.

opacity.label: Opacity
opacity.hint: Overall opacity of flames and embers.

emberAmount.label: Ember Amount
emberAmount.hint: How many rising sparks to draw, relative to the number of flames. 0 disables sparks.

edgeFade.label: Edge Fade
edgeFade.hint: 0 keeps a hard edge. Higher values fade flames whose base sits near the boundary. Sprites are still masked to the region, including holes.

randomSeed.label: Random Seed
randomSeed.hint: Leave empty or 0 to keep a stable layout derived from this scene, region, and behavior. Any other number reshuffles only this fire.

quality.name: Fire quality
quality.hint: Caps flames and embers per region and per scene. Lower this if a very large fire region drops frames. The saved region settings do not change.
